speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Do you have a history of tuberculosis or recent travel to areas where it is endemic, and have you noticed any pain or redness over the enlarged lymph node?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fact that the lymph node is painless, fixed, and accompanied by significant weight loss and night sweats is concerning for malignancy. I need to visualize the extent of the disease, so REQUEST TEST: CT_Scan_Chest_Abdomen_Pelvis and REQUEST IMAGES.

speaker: Doctor
text: The CT results showing massive lymphadenopathy in multiple regions, combined with your B-symptoms, strongly point toward a lymphoproliferative disorder. I need to confirm the cell type, so I am ordering a biopsy of the supraclavicular node; REQUEST TEST: Lymph_Node_Biopsy.
